item.title: Hello from Vajra
item.description: A placeholder post to kick off the Vajra blog.
item.content:encoded:
This is a placeholder post to kick off the Vajra blog. It exists so the blog layout, feeds, and navigation have real content to render while the first real write-ups are in progress.

Expect future posts to cover benchmark deep-dives, design notes on overlapping download, RAM staging, and CUDA transfer, and release announcements. Until then, check out the Overview and Quick Start to see what Vajra does today.

item.title: Benchmarks coming soon
item.description: Vajra benchmark reports will be published here as they are run.
item.content:encoded:
This space will host Vajra's published benchmark runs — throughput numbers, loading-latency comparisons against alternatives, and reproducibility notes for each setup.

The first report is in progress. Until then, see the Overview and Quick Start for what Vajra does today.
